q: A group Γ is sofic if it can be approximated by:
opts: Finite symmetric groups Sym(n) (almost-homomorphisms into permutation groups)
exp: Sofic (Gromov 1999, Weiss 2000): Γ is sofic if for every ε>0 and finite F⊂Γ, there exists σ: Γ→Sym(n) that is an ε-almost-homomorphism and almost-free on F. All amenable groups and residually finite groups are sofic. No non-sofic group is known.
